title: European Question Bank - DDI Profiles
description: DDI Profiles are formal, machine-actionable XML documents that specify additional constraints on the content of a DDI XML document, over and above those specified by the document's associated XSD schema. Firstly, the Profiles provide human-readable guidance for metadata professionals e.g. whether an element is optional, recommended or mandatory. Secondly, they support machine-actionable validation by the CESSDA Metadata Validator.
